name: Balance pass probe: armor fades 2.4 times as fast against the attacker's Level (absorb k 0.62 to 1.49, dodge k 0.4 to 0.96)
why: A full MID set sits at the 60% cap from about Level 45, one band back as well, so an armor step is worth nothing. This probe puts a MID plate set near 50% so a step can be read
